slides.heading: GUARANTEE INVOKED · 16 SEP 2026
slides.body: Ten days later, the same creditor served notice of insolvency petitions against Zee Learn and its subsidiary.

slides.heading: ₹ CRORE
slides.body: What Zee Learn expects others to pay is more than three times its own equity.

slides.heading: THE AUDITOR · JULY 2026
slides.text: “In the absence of assessment of impairment of the recoverable amount of Rs. 79,993.47 lakhs, we are unable to comment upon adjustments”
slides.who: FORD RHODES PARKS & CO · Q1 FY27 REVIEW

slides.heading: THE BEAR CASE
items: ONE CREDITOR NOW HOLDS EVERY CLAIM

slides.heading: THE LESSON
slides.label: WHERE THE RISK SITS
slides.body: The operating business earns money. But the guarantees are now larger than the company itself.
